headline: Hosbec estimates that hotels' boycott of the Imserso will cost 15,000 jobs
summary: The hotel employers' association Hosbec estimates that hotels' boycott of the Imserso program will cost 15,000 jobs. It warns of a negative impact of 150 million euros on the Valencian Community's finances.
why: The Imserso is Spain's state senior-tourism program, which fills hotels in the off-season. Boycotts disrupt occupancy and revenue for hotel operators and affect regional tax receipts.
